listing.name: Star Trek Across Dimensions
listing.summary: Adds a Star Trek-themed faction focused on the United Federation of Planets with a new power management system and shield mechanics.

description:
Hello everyone! It’s been quite some time since I’ve last made an appearance. It has been quite the hiatus. For right now, I can be found in the tall grass again.

I am happy to announce that after a long, long while, I am ready to release my newest Star Trek mod iteration. There’s been some major changes and complete overhauling. As such, it is fitting to give this new Star Trek mod a new mod name, which will be known Star Trek Across Dimensions from henceforth. I am dropping eras for a number of reasons.

First, I need to be completely up front and honest. This mod contains a lot of AI generation, HELP. I reiterate, AI generation help. The only area that is majority AI work is the code itself. The areas outside of code in this mod was my own work. For example, text was written by me, but cleaned up or refined by AI. It did not do all of the work. Second, even though the code was written by AI, I have reviewed hundreds of lines, inquiring and fixing errors myself. Despite this, I still cannot write a lick of code. But my understanding has drastically improved of Java due to this project. I do not blindly trust AI and have not. That does not mean that this mod is perfect or without errors but I have tried to sandbox the code as much as possible with my knowledge base.

I want to respect people’s right to choose. So, I am being as up front about the fact of AI usage as possible. I understand not want to support ANY AI generation or assistance. I too have my own negative experiences, qualms, and feelings towards AI as a whole. So, I am putting this in red below in case anyone skips my text dump.

DISCLAIMER: AI was used to build this mod! It’d be unfair of me to let people use this mod without knowing that fact. That’s not to say that I blindly let the AI build what I wanted. There was quite a bit of work on my part, to not just to get things functional, but I wanted to learn something as I worked. I am still not a coder. It doesn’t and hasn’t clicked for me, but my goal is to one day build a class by myself, in its entirety. If you are offended by the usage of AI, I understand. Your qualms and disgust are completely fair and earned. To some degree I agree with the disdain and distrust. If you cannot use this mod for your personal beliefs, I truly apologize for my failure as a person and a learner.

Skip if you don't want to read. But it reflects my ideas and mindset currently.

SpoilerWith that protective bit above to respect people’s values and rights to chose, we can start talking about the project. Star Trek Eras is dead.

The original idea of Star Trek Eras was to make every era available to play. When the mod first appeared and even now, the fact of the matter is, I cannot effectively support the original concept. If multiple people were building the project and there was a major, major total conversion, maybe it could make sense in Starsector as a mod. However, as the only person working on the project, it was far to expansive a project.

The task was an impossible barrier to completion. Someone else might have the tenacity, will, time, and ability to achieve it. I have to admit, I do not. Star Trek Eras requires sourcing ships for every era, balancing them, and making the ships make sense for their role and feel different from another. Then there was the fact that the Federation needs enemies. They needed contemporaries. As I was always going to prioritize the Federation, I’d be diverted from other major powers, putting in less work for them.

In its original iteration, Star Trek Eras, even up to its most recent version, took a lot of work to cobble together. Balancing the mod was difficult. It was a war of balancing between Star Trek lore and actual Starsector lore. Then there was the desire to ‘somewhat’ balance ships against vanilla vessels of Starsector.

The balancing, the additional factions, the endless list of ships, was far too much for me to handle. Therefore, with humility, I must admit that I cannot continue Star Trek Eras, reasonably. Star Trek Eras as an idea is not impossible to create, but it requires more work & time than I honestly have or even had.

So, when the tools finally appeared to help me achieve my vision of Star Trek in starsector, my first move was to reduce the scope of the project entirely. Therefore, Star Trek Across Dimensions was born. First, I will not be focusing on TNG era alone. It’s well documented and well understood by me.

I live & breathe TNG/VOY/DS9 … and possibly PIC era too. A simple reduction of era reduces the workload by a great deal for me. I’m no long tethered to trying to create TOS, ENT, TNG gameplay. Nor am I tied to balancing not just eras against each other but against Vanilla Starsector as well. It’s unrealistic, at least in the original concept I had.

For the future, I will be focusing entirely on one era. As a warning, my primary focus will be on a single faction, the United Federation of Planets. The reason? I just want to fly a Galaxy class around. Start with your favorites, right?

Here’s a fact, the mod is incomplete. It’s fleshed out a great deal, but there’s honestly a few things missing, a few descriptions forgotten, some errors floating around, some code incompatibility somewhere. The reason it’s being released right now, is to pilot and see if this gains traction.

Another reason is to see how other players feel about the mod gameplay wise. Is the Federation of planets an absolute god tier faction? Mid-to-late game, the answer is likely yes. I don’t see vanilla factions doing so well against the Federation. But it’s the player that matters most, not the faction. Does the player find ships below Intrepid and Excelsior to be balanced for Starsector?  (Because in truth, once you get to the bigger Cruisers and Capital Ships, it’s kind of cheese after that)

The Federation was always meant to be overpowered in Starsector, but nuanced. This is where my focus on balancing comes in a lot. That being said, a fleet of Federation ships with just 1 capital is pretty overwhelming to vanilla ships.

There’s some interesting mechanics for the game now, since I have help coding now. I’ll give you the basics. If a player decides to fly Federation ships, you will be required to have certain items on your ship. You’ll find out when you fly them. I’m not going to give everything away.

Next, Federation ships have new shield mechanics. It’s what gives them both an advantage and disadvantage. Lower tier ships are vulnerable to the shield mechanics. Capital Ships … not so much. It becomes a cheat with it.

I’ve created a system that works in tandem with flux if you want it too. This is the POWER system. I call it ESM for short, since all of the data is running based on a class I built called EnergySystemManager. On the UI, you will see PWR. Weapons USE power to fire. Shields require at least 1% power to remain active, otherwise they shut off.

It’s SUPPOSED to replace flux. However, as a default, I left both on. It’s not what I intended for this mod. Flux management is supposed to be removed playing Star Trek Across Dimensions. Instead, it comes down to shields and pwr. If you want to play as intended, just adjust the settings in lunalib’s modsettings in the left-hand corner. You can manage Flux being on or off there.

If you like the challenge of three systems, play on default. Just go straight into the game. If you want to play as intended, adjust the setting.

Outside of that, I encourage you to kind of figure out the mod as you go. I tried to make everything make sense. I am open to suggestions for improvements.

I am going to say a couple of things however.

1. Balance with vanilla is not at all priority. I can make micro-adjustments but I have spent A LOT of time getting the balance where I want. There could be some failed values with ordinance points or etc. I have been making micro adjustments as I play the game to fix unintended things. I will fix that. However, if you ask for vanilla balancing, respectfully, it’s not going to happen. This is how I intended the mod to be. I don’t wish to offend, be rude, or be hardheaded. I just want to be upfront. It’s not something I’m going to do. The game can easily be tweaked to your own preferences. The front-end of modding is incredibly easy. All you need to do is tweak some values if you wish to change how the mod works. Feel free to do so! In fact, if you want to take it and make a vanilla balance version, please, do so. Just ensure credits go to me for the original work.

2. Because I am releasing this now, it means I’ve entered into my burnout stage. I am tired and worn from focusing solely on this project. I usually have a rotation cycle of working on different things. Starsector happened to be in rotation cycle. So, if there’s no further word, it just means I’m in my resting period. Until I announce I will no longer develop this, my Star Trek work, in general, is never dead, just in hibernation. I say this because for right now, I will not be putting in major work. Minor work for right now, sure. Fixes, yes. Tweaking, absolutely. I just don’t want to promise major faction drops for right now.

3. I could not release absolutely fleshed out factions, but I could not release without some faction to go toe to toe with the Federation. So, I apologize for lack of content in the major factions. For right now, they too are being used for testing purposes.

4. The BORG is a major test. I encourage you to build a fleet and go against them. I’d like to know how it feels. Are they too strong? Are they too weak? For the most part, the Borg are honestly complete as far as ship set goes. Other areas need work, but the ships themselves are pretty much complete. I could possibly create assimilated variants of ships but to be honest, that’s only a possibility, not a promise.

5. AI for ship system usage is lacking or non-existent. I cannot for the life of me figure out how to script the use of it. IF anyone has any idea of what I can do, let me know. I am open to suggestions and honestly will PROMISE to actually do that. I actually want the AI to make use of the ship systems I created. Kind of pointless if they don’t.

[close]

aiDescription: Introduces a new faction based on the United Federation of Planets, featuring ships from the TNG, VOY, and DS9 eras. Implements a custom power system that replaces standard flux management, requiring players to manage power for weapons and shields. Includes unique shield mechanics that provide advantages and disadvantages depending on ship tier.
